text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malta, Australia air services sign agreement allowing Air Malta to operate two weekly services to Australia.
- Maltese observers at Bosnia elections. A team of three Maltese foreign ministry officials will be among U.N observers at the crucial elections in Bosnia this Saturday.
- Italian singer Ivana Spagna gives Malta concert.
- Caritas, the church organisation, says its centres for rehabilitating drug addicts are full.
- Nationalist Party planning Malta's future in its electoral programme, says party general-secretary. The NP has been in power since 1987. Elections are due by mid-1997.
